name: color-diary
desc_en: Turn an everyday photo into a single hand-made color diary page: six source-derived flat-gouache square fragments on a source-coloured background with a lowercase title. Use when the user sends a daily photo and wants it transformed into a color-collection poster, palette diary, or six-square art print. Triggers: 'color diary', 'make a diary page', 'process this photo into a poster', or any reques
